stories.title: Juan del Val, claro sobre lo que pasará si Sánchez convoca elecciones tras la derrota de los decretos de vivienda

en.title: Juan del Val clear about what will happen if Sánchez calls elections after defeat of housing decrees
en.summary: Spain faces potential early elections after parliament rejected the government's housing decree bills. Pedro Sánchez has entered a reflection period to decide next steps following the parliamentary defeat.

stories.title: Dos muertos y un desaparecido por el fuerte temporal en Cataluña

en.title: Two dead and one missing due to heavy storm in Catalonia
en.summary: A severe storm in Catalonia has caused two deaths and one person remains missing. One victim died when a wall collapsed at a camping site, while another was found after a garage flooded.

stories.title: La izquierda alternativa gana tiempo y fija para el 17 de octubre el lanzamiento del Frente Amplio y su líder para las generales

en.title: The alternative left gains time and sets October 17 for the launch of the Broad Front and its leader for the general elections
en.summary: Left-wing parties including IU, Comuns, Más Madrid, and Movimiento Sumar have scheduled October 17 to officially present their unified candidacy and electoral leader, regardless of whether early elections are called.

stories.title: Sumar presentará su Frente Amplio y anunciará el candidato electoral el 17 de octubre

en.title: Sumar will present its Broad Front and announce the electoral candidate on October 17
en.summary: Four leftist parties will present their Broad Front project and reveal their general election candidate on October 17. The decision was confirmed after a meeting between coalition ministers and party representatives.

stories.title: Mueren dos jóvenes ahogados en una playa del municipio alicantino de Guardamar de Segura

en.title: Two young people drown at a beach in Guardamar de Segura, Alicante
en.summary: Two individuals were rescued from the water at a beach in the Alicante municipality of Guardamar de Segura but did not respond to resuscitation attempts.

stories.title: Mueren dos jóvenes ahogados en una playa de Guardamar de Segura, Alicante

en.title: Two young people drown at a beach in Guardamar de Segura, Alicante
en.summary: Two young people died by drowning at a beach in Guardamar de Segura, Alicante.

stories.title: Mueren dos jóvenes ahogados en una playa de Guardamar del Segura

en.title: Two young people drown at a beach in Guardamar del Segura
en.summary: Two individuals drowned while swimming at a beach displaying a red flag warning in Guardamar del Segura.

stories.title: Los partidos de Sumar anuncian que presentarán a su candidato a las elecciones el 17 de octubre y su proyecto llamado Frente Amplio

en.title: Sumar parties announce they will present their candidate for elections on October 17 and their project called Broad Front
en.summary: The Sumar coalition has set October 17 as the date to present its electoral candidate and a political project named Broad Front, with several party figures mentioned as potential contenders.

stories.title: Sumar acelera su Frente Amplio y fija el 17 de octubre para su lanzamiento

en.title: Sumar accelerates its Frente Amplio and sets October 17 for its launch
en.summary: The coalition confirmed it will reveal its list leader on October 17, regardless of whether early elections occur, and emphasized housing as a central pillar of its political project.

stories.title: El temporal de Cataluña deja dos víctimas mortales en Tordera y Montornès, un desaparecido en Pineda y varios ES-Alert por riesgo de desbordamiento de ríos

en.title: The Catalonia storm leaves two deaths in Tordera and Montornès, one missing in Pineda and several ES-Alerts for river overflow risk
en.summary: A severe storm affected Catalonia with fatalities reported in two municipalities and one person missing, prompting maximum alerts in Girona and river overflow warnings across Barcelona and coastal areas.

stories.title: El temporal en Catalunya deja dos muertos en Tordera y Montornès y un desaparecido, en Pineda

en.title: The storm in Catalonia leaves two dead in Tordera and Montornès and one missing in Pineda
en.summary: A storm affected Catalonia causing two deaths and one disappearance, with some areas of the Maresme region receiving nearly 300 liters of rain per square meter since the previous afternoon.

stories.title: Sánchez usó a Zapatero como baza con Junts para intentar salvar los decretos de vivienda

en.title: Sánchez used Zapatero as leverage with Junts to try to save housing decrees
en.summary: The Spanish government coordinated with former president Zapatero to contact the Junts party leadership after the party announced it would vote against housing-related government decrees.

stories.title: Sánchez inaugura el Congreso de la Empresa Familiar al que regresa después de ocho años

en.title: Sánchez inaugurates the Family Business Congress, returning after eight years
en.summary: Spanish government president Pedro Sánchez will open the 29th Congress of the Family Business Institute tomorrow, marking his first participation in the event since 2018.

stories.title: La OPEP+ decide mantener congelada su oferta de petróleo en noviembre

en.title: OPEC+ decides to keep oil supply frozen in November
en.summary: OPEC+ maintained its crude oil supply levels unchanged for November, marking the second consecutive month of no change, according to the alliance led by Saudi Arabia and Russia.

stories.title: Irán reitera que no reabrirá el estrecho de Ormuz hasta que EEUU cumpla sus condiciones

en.title: Iran reiterates it will not reopen the Strait of Hormuz until the US meets its conditions
en.summary: Iran stated it continues reviewing details of a recent US proposal conveyed through Qatar and has transmitted preliminary considerations to Qatari mediators as part of indirect talks between Tehran and Washington.

stories.title: La Agencia Tributaria empieza a pagar el martes las ayudas directas a empresas y autónomos de Ceuta

en.title: Tax Agency begins paying direct aid to businesses and self-employed in Ceuta on Tuesday
en.summary: Starting October 6, Spain's Tax Agency will distribute government assistance to Ceuta businesses and self-employed workers to help them cope with economic effects from mass migration in late July.

en.title: Family Business: state of the art
en.summary: The 29th National Family Business Congress opened in Madrid, bringing together leading figures from Spain's family business sector.
